Reporting On Counterculture
An interview with Michelle Lhooq
November 02, 2026
Reporting On Counterculture
An interview with Michelle Lhooq
STUDY HALL COURSES:
▶ Pitch Workshop: Master the Art of Storytelling
In this live Study Hall
course
, Adam Popescu — a narrative journalist and author whose work has appeared in The New York Times, Bloomberg, and many other outlets — will cover everything from identifying stories to securing assignments. This workshop will focus on pitching (so bring your pitches!) and cover what it takes to succeed in the competitive world of freelance journalism using practical tips and techniques that have helped him build a career at some of the world's most prestigious publications. There will also be a Q&A with Adam at the end of the course.
The 1.5-hour
course
will take place
Monday, November 16th, at 10 AM / 1 PM ET
. The standard price is $99. Study Hall members can use the discount code “studyhallmember” to bring the price to $49.50. For any questions, email
support@studyhall.xyz
.
